You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26705, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26705` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26705 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6444305818, verbatim: "Guard departure the way the Access pillar and the Interfaces navigation already do (confirm plus `beforeunload`), with one shared guard. … Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling on the card.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `d31329f1`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` keeps `pillarDirty` (L1328) and reads only it for `confirmLeavePillar`, the `beforeunload` effect and `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` (L1330–L1351); `onDirtyChange={setPillarDirty}` is wired for two pillars (L2158, L2187), while the Data and Automations pillars report only `onHeldEditChange={setHeldEdit}` (L2128, L2140, L2150), which gates Publish, not departure.
- So the likely one shared guard is: departure is unsaved when `pillarDirty || heldEdit != null`, read by all three departure paths (pillar link, rail item switch, reload). Measure the rail item switch path separately; the card names it.

### Scope

File surface: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (+ the pillar files only if a pillar must report its held state differently) + tests: one per pillar (Data, Automations, Interfaces widget) for leave-confirm, rail-switch confirm and `beforeunload` with a held edit, plus the negative (no held edit ⇒ no prompt). Ablation: drop the held-edit term and the new tests go red. ⛔ No change to how a held edit is saved or to Publish gating. Seat 2 holds plugin packages and the Setup/admin pages; this card stays in Studio.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M, behaviour across three pillars). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected; say otherwise if the diff shows it. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell` if it is still published (it is `private: true` since #26483; then none).
